event: American Red Cross headquarters press appearance for the anti-landmine campaign, Washington, D.C.

observations.visualDescription: Short, smooth hair with a softly lifted crown and close sides. The top sweeps diagonally forward from a near-side part into a light, feathered fringe; wispy layered ends are visible. The back and nape are partly obscured.
observations.catalogMatchReasoning: This is a short layered crop with a streamlined outline and a closer perimeter than the earlier feathered shag. The photo supports the front and side shape; the nape is partly obscured, so its exact graduation remains uncertain.
